prompt_policy: Normalized briefs below describe the content; they are not claimed as a verbatim generation transcript.

briefs.posts-a: Orthographic overhead plan atlas, 16 isolated parts: light tripod / heavy nest, two physically distinct support and weapon models, magazines or ammunition boxes and separately broken receivers. Guns face east. Wide outside margins and source alpha gutters. Realistic weathered steel, wood and sandbags.
briefs.posts-b: Orthographic overhead plan atlas, 16 isolated parts: bolt launcher / spring spike-frame, two appearances. Fixed ground supports, separate rail/bow or moving spike carriage, bolt/string or return spring, wrecked moving parts. East-facing physical mechanism.
briefs.expedition-sites: Orthographic overhead atlas of twelve complete recoverable fixtures: two original physical compositions for fuel, garage, supply, archive, medical and ammunition. No invented active production, free stock or supernatural equipment.
